title: Add each and if blocks to the template engine
prompt: The small template engine in this project only substitutes `{{name}}` and `{{{raw}}}`. Add block support as described in README.md: `{{#each list}}...{{/each}}` and `{{#if value}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}`, including nesting, `{{this}}` and `{{@index}}` inside each. Existing behaviour (HTML escaping, dotted paths, raw output) must keep working. Run the tests with `npm test`.
